ipa.curves._bond_curves.curves.CreditCurveDefinition

Generates the credit curves for the definition provided

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.curves._bond_curves.curves.CreditCurveDefinition.

Syntax

CreditCurveDefinition(
    *,
    business_sector: BusinessSector | None = None,
    credit_curve_type_fallback_logic: OptStrings = None,
    curve_sub_type: CurveSubType | None = None,
    curve_tenors: OptStrings = None,
    economic_sector: EconomicSector | None = None,
    industry: Industry | None = None,
    industry_group: IndustryGroup | None = None,
    issuer_type: IssuerType | None = None,
    main_constituent_asset_class: MainConstituentAssetClass | None = None,
    rating: Rating | None = None,
    rating_scale_source: RatingScaleSource | None = None,
    reference_entity_type: ReferenceEntityType | None = None,
    seniority: Seniority | None = None,
    country: OptStr = None,
    currency: OptStr = None,
    id: OptStr = None,
    name: OptStr = None,
    reference_entity: OptStr = None,
    source: OptStr = None,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
business_sector BusinessSector | None No None Trbc business sector of the economic sector.
credit_curve_type_fallback_logic OptStrings No None Credit curve types list used to define the fallback logic in order to find the best credit curve. curves types are ordered by priority.
curve_sub_type CurveSubType | None No None
curve_tenors OptStrings No None User defined maturities to compute.
economic_sector EconomicSector | None No None Trbc economic sector of the issuer. available values are: basicmaterials, consumer cyclicals, consumer non-cyclicals, energy, financials, healthcare, industrials, technology, utilities
industry Industry | None No None Trbc industry of the industry group.
industry_group IndustryGroup | None No None Trbc industry group of the business sector.
issuer_type IssuerType | None No None Type of the issuer. available values are: agency, corporate, munis, nonfinancials, sovereign, supranational
main_constituent_asset_class MainConstituentAssetClass | None No None
rating Rating | None No None Rating of the issuer. the rating can be defined by using any of: "refinitiv", "s&p", "moody's", "fitch", "dbrs" convention
rating_scale_source RatingScaleSource | None No None
reference_entity_type ReferenceEntityType | None No None Type of the reference entity (mandatory if referenceentity is defined).
avialable values are: - chainric - bondisin - bondric - organisationid
- ticker
seniority Seniority | None No None Type of seniority. available values are: senior preferred, subordinate unsecured, senior non-preferred
country OptStr No None Country code of the issuer defined with alpha-2 code iso 3166 country code convention
currency OptStr No None Bond curve currency code
id OptStr No None
name OptStr No None
reference_entity OptStr No None Code to define the reference entity.
source OptStr No None Source or contributor code default value is "refinitiv"

Properties

Property Description
business_sector Trbc business sector of the economic sector.
country Country code of the issuer defined with alpha-2 code iso 3166 country code convention
credit_curve_type_fallback_logic Credit curve types list used to define the fallback logic in order to find the best credit curve. curves types are ordered by priority.

curve_sub_type

issuer_type Type of the issuer. available values are: agency, corporate, munis, nonfinancials, sovereign, supranational
main_constituent_asset_class
name

rating_scale_source
reference_entity Code to define the reference entity.
reference_entity_type Type of the reference entity (mandatory if referenceentity is defined). avialable values are: - chainric - bondisin - bondric - organisationid - ticker
